anomalies_carried_forward_for_review: beta(M0) == beta(M1) EXACTLY at every parameter set -- reported by the producer as a forced mathematical identity (convolution distributes over mixtures), not a defect. I independently checked the argument's logical structure (Law(Xe+D) for D a mixture of D_1..D_k with weights p_1..p_k equals the same-weighted mixture of Law(Xe+D_1)..Law(Xe+D_k), by linearity of the law of total probability over sums of independent variables) and find it sound as stated, but this is exactly the kind of structural claim the Validator and Red Team must independently re-derive, not take on my reading alone.

beta(M2) at ML-KEM-1024 (617) is 255 bits below beta(M0) (872) -- roughly two orders of magnitude beyond H-MLKEM-11aabf's predicted 2-4 bit minimum_effect. The producer explicitly declines to conclude whether this is a genuine effect or an artifact of the severely underdetermined m<<n regime (reduced_m=236 vs base m=n=1024) that primal_bdd may not be well-calibrated for. This is the single most decision-relevant open question this batch produced and both reviews should treat it as a PRIMARY target, not a footnote.
